title: Chapter 773
text:
The spectators could not calm down for a long time as they watched the Black Star Corps leave.

At this moment, the position of the Black Star Corps rose to the same level as the Bloodshed Land in their hearts.

On the way back, Han Xiao took a detour and passed by a Star. In order to test the effect of the Heber Stellar Furnace Training, he told the fleet to stop and flew toward the surface of the Star.

Without wearing a mechanical suit, the intense radiation and high temperature directly shone on his body. The closer he was, the higher the temperature.

When he was close enough, the Heber Stellar Furnace Training on the interface turned from gray to bright, indicating that it could be used.

After investing millions of experience, Han Xiao began his first training session.

The energy in his body boiled instantly, crazily absorbing the energy of the Star's radiation. His skin instantly turned red, and the brightness continued to increase.

"Just nice, I can also activate the radiation absorption at the same time."

This time, a solar prominence shot out from the surface of the Star like a red tsunami. Han Xiao did not dodge and allowed the Star's energy to drown him. A small portion of his health was lost.

In the high temperature environment, his health continued to drop, but it was quickly replenished by his health mana. The effect of the Stellar Furnace Training was dependent on how long he stayed on the Star. The reason why it was a high-grade secret technique was because Supers below Grade A could rarely survive on a Star. With Han Technician's tankiness, he could stay on the Star until the end of time.

"Now, it's really like taking a bath on a Star." Han Xiao played with a ball of Star's energy, slapping it on his chest like bubbles. He shook his head and laughed.

After enduring for half an hour, the interface indicated that the training effect had reached its limit. Han Xiao then left the Star, and the number of times he trained the Stellar Furnace Training became one, increasing his energy by twenty-five.

"Every time is half an hour, and every time I gain 25 Energy, I can train 650 times. After training all the times, I can gain more than 16,000 Energy. In terms of recovery rate, I can recover more than 80,000 HP."

Han Xiaoxin was extremely happy. After reaching Beyond Grade A, increasing one's strength had become more difficult than before. It was extremely rare to have such an opportunity to increase one's strength by so much. It felt like a peerless divine technique.

After testing the effects of the Stellar Furnace, Han Xiao had the fleet depart. After dealing with the army's affairs, he would have the time to practice this Energy Cultivation secret technique.

"The Black Star Corps has allied with the Red Empire. The Red Empire has announced the ownership of the Evolution Cube and forced the Arcane Church to retreat."

"Black Star became famous in a single battle. The Tyrant had no choice but to retreat!"

"Several of our reporters at the scene were unfortunately killed. According to incomplete statistics, the number of spectators who were injured or killed has reached tens of millions."

The dust of the battle had settled, but the impact it caused swept across the Shattered Star Ring like a hurricane, washing the headlines of all the major news channels with blood.

This event had attracted the attention of too many people. The five Beyond Grade As of the Shattered Star Ring had gathered. Although the process was not long, the situation had changed many times. To everyone, Black Star was the biggest star of this event, and he had fought with the Tyrant on equal footing. The most shocking thing was that the Red Empire had changed sides and announced that Black Star had joined them. No one had expected such a situation.

Everyone knew that this meant that another Beyond Grade A had gained a foothold in the galaxy, and a new enormous organization was about to be born. What happened today was enough to be recorded in the history of the Shattered Star Ring. This was a signal that would change the structure of the Star Field.

On the second day after the battle, the Black Star Corps issued a recruitment order to the entire Star Field.

All of a sudden, countless people who had been observing the situation were tempted.

The Black Star Corps had the support of the Red Empire, so they did not have to worry about lacking resources. Furthermore, the leader of the faction, Black Star, was a Beyond Grade A who had proven his strength. Such a good new organization had a bright future, and there were too many benefits to joining.

The recruitment order of the Black Star Corps was like a deep water bomb, causing huge waves in the Shattered Star Ring. On the second day after the recruitment order was issued, spaceships set off from various Star Clusters, heading straight for the Black Star Corps headquarters in the Colton Star Cluster.

This was the largest recruitment in the history of the army, and Philip would receive tens of millions of resumes and applications every day.

Many organizations in the Shattered Star Ring also extended an olive branch to the Black Star Corps.

"You want to merge under my name and let me be the chief director of the Mercenary League? That's not a problem, but you will continue to be in charge of the daily affairs. That's what I meant. After some time, we will jointly announce to the Star Field that the Mercenary League is under my name. "

After hanging up the communication with Gureja, Han Xiao rubbed his nose. Over the past few days, who knew how many organizations had contacted him and made all sorts of requests.

Some of the organizations that wanted to borrow his name were usually organizations that he had a good relationship with. For example, Serbia the Fifth of Godora had called the day before and said that he wanted to hold another political visit. He also expressed his hope that the Black Star Corps would not move their headquarters and would remain near Planet Golden Gate.

Because of the existence of the Black Star Corps, Planet Golden Gate had welcomed a period of explosive development. Furthermore, it was a transportation hub, so its economy was extremely prosperous.

Serbia the Fifth had even planned to invite Han Xiao to become an honorary officer of Godora, but this plan was a little too grand and was rejected by Han Xiao. One Golden Gal Badge was enough. If he were to be awarded another honor, it would mean that the Black Star Corps had expressed their stance, which would be disadvantageous to the surrounding areas.

A single Star System civilization was not enough to satisfy Han Xiao's appetite. With a godly tool like the Evolution Cube in his hands, it would not be worth it if he did not use it to unify more civilizations. Thus, it was not suitable for him to stand on Godora's side so openly.

Many Star System civilizations in the Colton Star Cluster had also contacted him. Many of them were partners who shared the mining rights of resource planets. Now that he had established his position through the battle with the Tyrant, these civilizations all wanted to deepen their relationship. Other than exchanging for the position of a Beyond Grade A, more importantly, they all wanted to borrow the Evolution Cube.

The terms of deepening the alliance included expanding the mining area of resource planets and establishing more divisions. In conclusion, it was basically the civilizations taking out their own share of the cake and giving it to Han Xiao, accepting the Black Star Corps as a new member of the upper echelons of the Galaxy.

However, regarding the agreement regarding the Evolution Cube, Han Xiao had been keeping the other civilizations in suspense and had yet to finalize it. With something as good as the Evolution Cube in his hands, he did not plan to rush to exchange it for benefits. After all, he was the seller's market, and it would be more stable to take things slowly.

There was also a portion of small armed organizations that requested to be merged into the Black Star Corps. There were many organizations led by Calamity Grades, and even a few organizations in Section Zero wanted to become a member of the army. After all, the temptation of the Red Empire was too great.

The final portion was the galactic financial groups. They were all investors, and they were eager to invest to solve the problem of the expansion of the army. Money had extraordinary power, and the scale of the expansion of the Black Star Corps depended to a certain extent on the investments of these financial groups.

After resting for a few minutes, his communicator rang again. This time, it was Zoel calling.

"Black Star, no, I should call you Your Excellency Black Star," Zoel said with a smile.

Han Xiao also joked a little before asking, "Envoy, why are you looking for me today?"

When it came to serious matters, Zoel stopped chatting and said, "Now that we have announced our alliance, the subsequent cooperation will also be carried out gradually. Because of your alliance, the dynasty has decided to deal with the matters of the Shattered Star Ring first, which is the secret war you mentioned."

"Oh?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"Klent is prepared to submit a proposal to replan the Colton Star Cluster and Sol Cluster to the Galaxy Central Civilization Court, which will be mediated and decided by our three Universal Civilizations."

The Galaxy Central Civilization Court was the most official civilization alliance led by the three Universal Civilizations. Basically, all the Supercluster Civilizations, Star Cluster Civilizations, Star System Civilizations, and even some special races in the Star Field had seats in it. It united most of the civilizations in the universe and was used to discuss all kinds of matters. It was very official.

"Klent is also your ally. What do you plan to do?" Han Xiao asked.

"You're right. We plan to talk to Klent privately and ask them to give up the idea of submitting the proposal." Zoel nodded. Klent was their ally, so the dynasty would not go overboard. They would not sit by and watch Klent submit the proposal without any help.

In fact, Klent did not want Purple Crystal's territory because of the Red Empire. They were just using the dynasty's flag to satisfy their own ambitions. This kind of thing was too common. As long as they did not cross the line, the Red Empire would turn a blind eye. Now that there was a need, they had the right to stop Klent's plan.

Of course, the dynasty would compensate them and give Klent extra benefits in the territory division of the Flickering World.

"Klent knows what's good for them. They'll agree. Furthermore, it's useless even if they don't agree. The Arcane Church was tricked by us. They'll definitely block Klent's proposal on this matter. If we don't say anything, the proposal won't pass." Zoel shrugged.

"That's true." Han Xiao nodded. He did not think that the Arcane Church would be willing to take this lying down. They would definitely try to get back at them in other places. The political stage was one of them.

"Now, your Black Star Corps and Bloodshed Land are both our allies. We'll work together to develop the Flickering World in the future. After solving the problem of the secret war, you guys need to have a good talk and become friends," Zoel said.

The Red Empire valued the development of the Flickering World, and the two allies in the Shattered Star Ring were the pioneers of the exploration. The dynasty did not want to see the progress of the exploration of the new Star Field being affected by the conflict between the two allies. Even if it was only on the surface, they had to see it.

"Alright, I'm fine with it. I just don't know what Ty-Ty is thinking." Han Xiao shrugged.

Hearing this, Zoel smiled helplessly. The Tyrant was the one who had suffered the most this time.

After pausing for a while, Zoel continued. "There's one last thing. The dynasty will send the first batch of people to be modified by the Evolution Cube over. I'll inform you then."

Han Xiao nodded. This was the content of the deal. He would give the Red Empire the right to use the Evolution Cube.

He did not know who the first batch of people selected by the Red Empire would be. They would most likely be the elites of the dynasty. Han Xiao felt that there might be famous people he 'knew' among them.

After chatting for a while longer, Han Xiao ended the communication. Just as he hung up, his communicator rang again. It was an unknown number.

Han Xiao paused for a while before picking up the call. Suddenly, his expression changed.

On the screen was EsGod's ugly face.

"Black Star." EsGod had a strange smile on his face as he nodded.

Han Xiao stared at the screen and did not say anything. He did not expect EsGod to contact him. He was still quite wary of this infamous Beyond Grade A brutes.

"I have a deal to discuss with you."

"Speak."

EsGod smiled. "Don't worry, I won't snatch your Evolution Cube. You're different from Sisko. You're not as stubborn as him."

"What do you want to say?"

"The Evolution Cube is in your hands now," EsGod said slowly. "Let's make a deal. You let me use the Evolution Cube once, and I'll help you do something."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He definitely would not believe EsGod when he said that he would not snatch the Evolution Cube. Making a deal with EsGod was no different from asking a tiger for its skin.

However, without waiting for him to reply, EsGod continued. "I understand. Your alliance with the Red Empire has just begun, and you still have concerns. However, for someone like you who is bound by order, you might need a lawless brutes to help you do some things. You don't have to reply to me in a hurry. Give me your answer when you've thought it through."

EsGod smiled and hung up.

Han Xiao frowned. His finger paused on the option to delete EsGod's encrypted number.

He was silent for a long time.

His finger slipped.

EsGod's number was blacklisted.

It was not deleted.

Spaceships landed on Blue Star one after another. The logos of various financial groups were engraved on them. These were material transport ships, carrying a huge amount of resources.

Bennett led the Aquamarine Federation's diplomatic group to stand at the dock of the hangar. He looked at the mechanical workers moving the material boxes down one by one with emotion.

As the hometown of a Beyond Grade A, they had received even more investments from galactic financial groups.

Bennett could not help but turn around. Through the entrance of the hangar, he looked at the huge Black Star statue in the center of the city. A look of relief and gratitude flashed through his eyes.
